So contradiction with guideline recommendation to give gentamicin (S005). Also missing monitoring of gentamicin levels if given (but withheld). Completeness: Missing dose, missing alternative, missing mention of timing of cultures (though L012). So 3.

Utility: Plan gives actions but incomplete. 3.
